# 🌍 EasyTrade — Customer Acquisition & Conversion Analysis
*7-day review of how visitors move through key actions (deposit, buy, sell, withdraw), and where — geographically and technically — that journey succeeds or breaks down.*

Data is sourced from real user session telemetry (RUM), not backend logs, so this reflects what customers actually experienced in the browser.

## Funnel Overview
Each action a customer can take is tracked start → finish (or error). The table below is the full funnel.

input.value:
fetch bizevents, from:-7d
| filter event.provider == "easytrade-frontendreverseproxy"
| fieldsAdd action = arrayElement(splitString(event.type, "."), 2), phase = arrayElement(splitString(event.type, "."), 3)
| summarize started = countIf(phase == "start"), finished = countIf(phase == "finish"), errored = countIf(phase == "error"), by:{action}
| fieldsAdd conversion_pct = round(finished * 100.0 / started, decimals:1)
| sort started desc

sections.markdown:
## Where Users Drop Off
Conversion is already 99%+ across every action — this platform has essentially no drop-off problem today. The chart below shows the raw drop count (started minus finished) per action, so any regression is easy to spot at a glance in future reviews.

input.value:
fetch bizevents, from:-7d
| filter event.provider == "easytrade-frontendreverseproxy"
| fieldsAdd action = arrayElement(splitString(event.type, "."), 2), phase = arrayElement(splitString(event.type, "."), 3)
| summarize started = countIf(phase == "start"), finished = countIf(phase == "finish"), by:{action}
| fieldsAdd dropped = started - finished
| fields action, dropped
| sort dropped desc

sections.markdown:
## Geographic Conversion Patterns
Conversion rate by country (countries with fewer than 20 sessions excluded for statistical significance). Sorted ascending to surface the weakest-converting markets first — though as the funnel overview shows, nothing here is currently a concern.

input.value:
fetch bizevents, from:-7d
| filter event.provider == "easytrade-frontendreverseproxy"
| fieldsAdd phase = arrayElement(splitString(event.type, "."), 3)
| summarize started = countIf(phase == "start"), finished = countIf(phase == "finish"), by:{geo.country.name}
| fieldsAdd conversion_pct = round(finished * 100.0 / started, decimals:1)
| filter started > 20
| fields geo.country.name, started, conversion_pct
| sort conversion_pct asc

sections.markdown:
## Reach — Session Volume by Country
Where the traffic actually comes from, independent of conversion rate. Useful for prioritizing localization, support hours, or marketing spend.

input.value:
fetch bizevents, from:-7d
| filter event.provider == "easytrade-frontendreverseproxy"
| summarize sessions = count(), by:{geo.country.name}
| sort sessions desc
| limit 10

sections.markdown:
## Device & Browser Trends
Session volume by browser over time — useful for prioritizing cross-browser QA and spotting any browser-specific issues early.
